phrase: a Smart Wheelchair and Assistive Device Business
verdict: Yes, for a mission-driven hardware team. Sahayatha from Coimbatore pitched a smart wheelchair with an assistive cleansing device on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from all five sharks. Bedridden and disabled patients and their caregivers need better equipment, but the product must be affordable and robust.
angle: Assistive devices for people with limited mobility reduce the burden on caregivers. Hospitals, elder-care homes and families buy them. Government schemes for disabled people and CSR funding can support sales.
